# Beehive Design

> Ireland's #1 SEO agency and digital marketing company. Expert SEO consultants delivering SEO services, local SEO, eCommerce & Shopify SEO, technical SEO and AI search visibility optimisation for businesses across Dublin, Cork, Galway and nationwide Ireland.

Beehive Design is an SEO agency and web design studio helping Irish businesses rank higher on Google and AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity), grow organic traffic and turn searches into sales. Free SEO audits. Packages from EUR 300/month.
